question: Within a radius of 200 kilometers, where can I locate museum on the journey from Sloth Encounters, Hauppauge, NY to MAC 650 Gallery, Middletown, CT?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sloth Encounters%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hauppauge%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MAC 650 Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Middletown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), route_buffer AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(rl.geom::geography, 200000) AS buffered_geom FROM route_line rl ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, route_buffer rb, route_line rl WHERE p.museum = 'yes' -- Filter for museums AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, rb.buffered_geom) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, rl.geom::geography) ASC;
